data.one_liner: Scratch card widget which temporarily hides content from the user.
data.what_it_does: Provides a scratch card widget that covers content with a solid color or custom image, allowing users to scratch it away to reveal what's underneath. It supports tracking progress, threshold callbacks, and programmatic control.
use_when: You want to build a scratch-off game or promotional feature in your app
You need to temporarily hide content until the user interacts with it
avoid_when: You need complex physics or game engines
You are targeting web platforms other than CanvasKit
strengths: Supports custom cover images and solid colors
Tracks scratch progress and triggers callbacks on threshold
Programmatic control with reset and reveal methods
weaknesses: Web support is limited to CanvasKit only
data.minimal_example:
Scratcher(
  brushSize: 30,
  threshold: 50,
  color: Colors.red,
  onChange: (value) => print("Scratch progress: $value%"),
  onThreshold: () => print("Threshold reached, you won!"),
  child: Container(
    height: 300,
    width: 300,
    color: Colors.blue,
  ),
)
